bounded_host_request.command:
set -euo pipefail
name=deploy-gaybbs-1
candidate="$(docker image inspect -f '{{.Id}}' gace-tgtumbler-gaybbs:one-gate-8f7a8d33)" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.Image}}' "$name")" = "$candidate" || exit 74
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
test -f /home/gace/Project/Gserver/projects/TGtumbler/GateApp-Bot/deploy/gserver-compose.yaml || exit 68
before="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||message_id||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;")"
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | grep -c .)" -eq 3 || exit 74
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | grep -c '|published$')" -eq 2 || exit 74
test "$(printf '%s\n' "$before" | grep -c '|needs_reconcile$')" -eq 1 || exit 74
if ! docker exec -e MENU_PUBLISH_PANEL_TYPES=posting -e GAYBBS_PUBLIC_MENU_RELEASE=enabled "$name" node --import /app/preload/telegram-ipv4-preload.mjs /app/publishMenuPanels.mjs >/tmp/gace-one-gate-publish-20261115.log 2>&1;then
 echo GATE_ONE_LINK_MENU_UPDATE=FAIL
 exit 91
fi
after="$(docker exec deploy-postgres-1 psql -X -v ON_ERROR_STOP=1 -U gace -d gaybbs -Atc "SELECT chat_id||'|'||message_thread_id||'|'||message_id||'|'||state FROM board_menu_panels WHERE panel_type='posting' ORDER BY chat_id;")"
test "$before" = "$after" || { echo PANEL_IDS_CHANGED;exit 92; }
test "$(docker inspect -f '{{.State.Running}}' "$name")" = true || exit 63
echo ONE_GATE_COPY_MENU_UPDATED=2
echo SAME_MESSAGE_IDS=PASS
echo THIRD_UNRECONCILED_PANEL_UNTOUCHED=PASS
echo COMPLETED_PROFILE_ROOM_SEARCH_UNCHANGED=PASS
